title: Boys Riding Donkey in Rural Field, 1967 B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A square black and white snapshot photo featuring two young boys outdoors in an open grassy pasture surrounded by trees. One boy is riding on the back of a donkey or small mule while heading away from the view, and the second boy follows closely on foot. The left white margin is factory-printed with 'JUN 67', dating the development of the photograph to June 1967. The scene captures a nostalgic moment of carefree rural childhood during late 1960s America.
